Open LOW points to record as defects (numbers from ORCH): (1) 05b F1: no test probes the lock or admin-delay Retry-After at a fractional second (mutant ceil→floor survives); the code is right (my probe: 899 at 898.5 s left); (2) the TOTP turn-off form shows its code prompt under the error label (the same pattern M-4 fixed on login.html); (3) acceptance M-1: Chrome «Failed to load resource» lines for expected refusals (GET /api/auth/me 401 on every signed-out page); (4) M-2: reset.html with a live session makes one refused POST (403 csrf_refused) and one repeat; (5) M-3: the setup token field is a text field (password field?); (6) M-5: __Host-sai_s/Secure only on https — post-deploy read; (7) M-6: on Windows a stop by pid ends the server at once (no graceful stop observed); (8) the stale comment at app/server/routes/auth.js:545 (POST /api/auth/password): it says «An unused reset link of the admin», while deleteUnusedResets(req.q, row.id) removes the unused links of whichever user changes his password; (9) audit rows for unknown e-mails: one row per failed login, bounded only by the per-address limit (my probe: 30 failures from 30 addresses → 30 rows); (10) REVIEWER P4-1 (empty #prompt paragraph may add a margin), P2-1/P2-2 and SEC F4 (pool of 3 held during scrypt) if ORCH keeps accepted lows as defects.

(a) `select id::text as id … order by id` orders by the text alias (1, 10, 11 …): a chain check over such rows breaks; order by the table column (the repo does: audit_log.id; my own first probe fell into it, and step 06 fixed AC-1 for the same cause). (b) A criterion that needs a commit that exists only after the release push (REQ-120 c5) cannot be met at step 9: write such parts as post-push checks of RELEASE-FINALIZER. (c) An Addition that changes a guarded list (decisions/0137 Addition 3) must add its guard row in the design table at once (AP-068 class; RV-F2). (d) A security record that a criterion asks «row by row» must carry the row ids of the list it answers (RV-F1).
